interfaces.cli: Native machine-only scoped JSONL batch requests; one compact JSON summary; no MCP
interfaces.gui: Minimal ImGui/Win32/DX11 controls using the same protected adaptive core

cleanup_plans: default autonomous cleanup with positive disposability evidence
custom explicit directory or file list

authorization.irreversible_run_authorization: explicit request flag after plan/scope selection

execution.membership: Complete batch frozen before mutation; additions/replacements excluded
execution.staging: Bounded sorted runs and indexed protected scratch files; compact resource-admitted scheduler metadata
execution.admission: Live RAM/commit/job/handle/disk/CPU budgets; no fixed target count; reject whole batch before mutation if insufficient
execution.preparation: Bounded independent work with pinned ancestry, per-worker buffers and shared volume facts
execution.scheduling: Shared physical-device budgets, measured concurrency feedback, ready child-parent dependencies
execution.failure_recovery: Only after the full first pass; untouched targets retain explicit pending provenance
execution.quick_resume: In-session only; no external plan/report imported as retry authority
execution.crash: Unknown or partial completion; never automatically rescan to discover a replacement batch
execution.outcomes: Paged disk evidence, compact counters, bounded diagnostics; no per-file process startup
execution.system_protection: Core-enforced fail-closed nofollow and fresh identity/protection checks

semantics.quick: Permanent logical namespace deletion; no content overwrite, verification or secure-erasure promise
semantics.overwrite: Original verified logical overwrite requirements, authenticated checkpoints and explicit downgrade grants retained
semantics.hardlinks: Separate selected names; unselected aliases survive; shared contents never overwritten
semantics.space: Observed allocation may prioritize work; free-space observations are not attributable reclaimed-byte guarantees
semantics.steam: No verified private Steam uninstall algorithm is claimed

delivery.git: Maintained source/config/docs/assets/tests only; immutable dependency locks
delivery.archive: Clean single-root Source ZIP, exact commit, manifest and SHA256
delivery.acceptance: Required unit/integration/isolated destructive gates plus platform evidence; incomplete hardware/platform matrix remains RC
